media.title: Looking west on Hollywood Boulevard — Tichnor postcard, c. 1930–1945
media.description: Linen-finish picture postcard looking west along Hollywood Boulevard, with the Equitable Building and the Pantages Theatre on the right. It was published by Tichnor Brothers of Boston through its Los Angeles office, the Tichnor Art Company, as card 62693.
media.altText: Coloured postcard of a busy boulevard lined with tall commercial buildings, a vertical Pantages sign, awnings and parked cars.
media.publicCaption: Hollywood Boulevard looking west, on a Tichnor postcard of about 1930–1945.
media.publicCreditLine: Tichnor Brothers, Boston (Tichnor Art Company, Los Angeles), card 62693; Boston Public Library, Tichnor Brothers Postcard Collection; via Digital Commonwealth.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. Tichnor Brothers of Boston published the card in the United States between about 1930 and 1945, and neither side carries a copyright notice; a work published in the United States before 1978 without notice entered the public domain on publication. The Boston Public Library, which holds the card, records no known copyright restrictions.

places.publicNote: Hollywood is used here as the district associated with Kaper’s American film career.
